title: 2022 XCub CC19
description: A beautifully equipped 2022 XCub featuring the highly coveted 215 HP engine and classic tailwheel configuration. For pilots who believe flying should be as much fun as it is practical, this XCub delivers in every category. The upgraded horsepower provides spirited climb performance, excellent useful load capability, and the confidence to tackle demanding backcountry missions, while the tailwheel setup preserves the pure stick-and-rudder experience that has made Cubs legendary.

title: 2017 XCub CC19
description: Take to the backcountry in this impressive 2017 CubCrafters NX Cub CC19-180, powered by a Lycoming IO-390 producing 215 HP and equipped with a Hartzell Trailblazer composite propeller. Featuring Garmin G3X avionics, Garmin GMC 307 autopilot, a reinforced fuselage, and ABI 26” Bushwheels, this Cub is built for serious backcountry capability. Maintained by CubCrafters and repainted in March 2025. Please visit www.AircraftBidder.com for more information.

title: 2021 XCub CC19
description: Southwest Aero presents this exceptional 2021 CubCrafters XCub with only 195 SNEW. Equipped with a fuel-injected Lycoming CC393i engine, 76-inch Hartzell propeller, Garmin G3X Touch avionics suite, Grove aluminum spring gear, 29-inch Alaska Bushwheel tundra tires, custom yellow and metallic silver paint scheme with carbon fiber vinyl accents and premium leather interior. This highly equipped aircraft delivers exceptional STOL performance, modern capability, and refined backcountry comfort.

title: 2022 Carbon Cub FX2
description: N1111B is a beautiful Carbon Cub FX-2 that is equally at home on a remote backcountry strip or a quiet lake. With the FX-2’s impressive short-field performance and rugged Carbon Cub DNA, it makes an exceptional platform for exploring places that most airplanes simply can’t reach. Add the custom amphibious floats, and N1111B becomes a seriously capable seaplane, opening up access to lakes, rivers, and remote waterfront destinations while retaining the flexibility to return to conventional gear.

title: 2014 Carbon Cub SS
description: N412CC is everything that has made the Carbon Cub SS one of the most sought-after backcountry aircraft on the market—lightweight, capable, and an absolute joy to fly. Whether you're chasing remote strips, exploring the mountains, or simply looking for a Cub that turns heads wherever it lands, this aircraft delivers the performance and pedigree to do it all.

title: 2016 XCub CC19
description: Experience the ultimate adventure machine with this CubCrafters XCub — the perfect balance of power, performance, and precision craftsmanship. N555ZM has exceptional STOL capabilities, this aircraft takes you places few others can, from backcountry strips to remote lakesides. If you’re looking for unmatched versatility and pure flying freedom, this XCub delivers it all.

title: 2009 Sport Cub S2
description: Versatile and reliable, N6990R is capable of taking you into the back country, sightseeing windows open, or picnics under the wing. A classic design with great flying qualities. The AOSS struts make three-point and wheel landings look easy. Cruise the countryside at 5 gph and enjoy a cross country into America’s grass fields to experience GA at its most magical. Full ADS-B in/out to get you anywhere. Always hangared and meticulously maintained. Fresh annual inspection underway!

title: 2007 Sport Cub SS
description: The perfect entrant into backcountry aviation and tailwheel flying - the Sport Cub SS! With just the right amount of power to keep you thrilled yet safe, this airplane is a classic for a reason! Great pedigree, cool scheme, and just enough technology to have plenty of fun, N579CC is ready for its new home!

title: 2022 Carbon Cub Ex2
description: N81UE, “Blue” is ready for her new home! This homebuilt EX-3 boasts a constant speed propeller, a G3X, Acme Suspension, and a whole bunch more. The Carbon Cub is best known for its ridiculous performance. Whether you’re camping under the wing in the middle of the wilderness, or ripping around the pattern, this cub is a performer. She can carry a lot, land short, take off shorter, and cruise fast by cub standards. She has been fabulously maintained and will treat her new caretaker right.

title: 2018 Carbon Cub Fx-3
description: Aerista is proud to present N25FX - a machine that expands your reach. This Carbon Cub FX-3 boasts big tires, a hearty suspension setup, and a constant speed prop. Additionally, with the CubCrafters World VFR Panel setup, operate this cub with the confidence to get into the biggest, and smallest runways. It’s no secret - the number one second airplane for Cirrus owners is the Cub platform. It’s sporty, carries a ton, and goes places other airplanes could only dream of.

title: 2021 NXcub NXcub
description: Meet N15NX—the perfect blend of backcountry performance and cross-country comfort. Built for STOL flying, it delivers confident short takeoffs and landings while keeping you comfortable with leather seats and a smooth, capable autopilot for longer trips. N15NX is a December 2021 release, finished in eye-catching red with carbon accents and equipped with pulse lights for added visibility, it stands out on any ramp.

title: 2020 Carbon Cub EX-3
description: TT 329 Hrs, Engine 329 Hrs Lycoming CC 363i Fuel Injected Engine (186 hp), Prop 329 Hartzell Trailblazer 83″ Constant Speed Prop, Garmin G3X Touch Glass Panel, Garmin GMC 305 Autopilot, Garmin GTR 200 COM Radio, Integrated Engine Monitoring System, Digital Fuel Computer Two 12V auxiliary outlet (front and rear), 406 ELT, Alaskan Bush Wheels (29 inch), Baby Bush wheel tail wheel (Free castering) Heavy Duty Landing Gear, Heavy Duty Fabric

title: 2020 NXcub NXcub
description: This NX Cub, loaded with extras, is your ticket to STOL flying and backcountry access. Covering the full array of low stall speed and fantastic cruise speed in the cub world, the NX cub opens the door to all sorts of new environments and experiences.
